title: E2E Smoke Tests — Critical Flows
description: Add Playwright E2E smoke tests for critical user flows: homepage, shop, product detail, and cart.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage test: page loads, hero renders, navigation visible
Shop test: page loads, product cards render, filtering works
Product test: page loads, product info displays, add-to-bag works
Cart test: adding product updates bag count, cart page shows item
All tests pass with `npx playwright test`
Tests use page.goto() and basic selectors (no complex assertions)
verification: Run `npx playwright test` — all tests pass
Dev server is running during test execution
context: Playwright is configured in playwright.config.ts. The dev server runs on http://localhost:3000. Write minimal smoke tests that verify pages load and key elements render. Use test.describe() to group flows. Use expect(page).toHaveTitle() and page.locator() for assertions. Keep tests simple — happy path only, no edge cases. The tests should verify: 1) Homepage loads with hero section, 2) Shop page loads with product cards, 3) Product detail page loads with product info, 4) Add-to-bag updates the cart badge.
